Ironhead Security • SOP-88

Sensory Distress Scale

Standard operating procedures for identifying and managing neurodivergent sensory overload events in the field. "Recognize the static before it becomes the storm."

Level 1: The Rumble
Stable / Monitor

Internal State: System friction detected. Lights appear 10% brighter. Background noise (HVAC, traffic) stops filtering out and becomes distinct.

  • Signs: Increased stimming (tapping, chewing), slight irritability, adjusting clothing.
  • Protocol: "Monitor." Reduce unnecessary inputs. No intervention required.
Example:

Cassidy aggressively chewing gum while mixing a track because the snare drum sound isn't sitting right.

Level 2: The Glitch
Input Lag

Internal State: Processing speed drops. Thoughts become "sticky." The brain starts prioritizing sensory defense over social niceties.

  • Signs: Echolalia (repeating words), sensory seeking (hoodie up), "flat" face, delayed responses.
  • Protocol: "Create Space." Yes/No questions only. Do not demand eye contact.
Example:

Jessica Miller typing on her phone instead of speaking because her voice feels "too heavy" to use.

Level 3: The Shutdown
Safe Mode

Internal State: Input cut off. The world feels underwater. Total dissociation to protect the brain from overload.

  • Signs: Non-verbal / Whispering. The "Thousand-Yard Stare." Hiding in small spaces (under desks).
  • Protocol: "Perimeter Check." Guard the door. Do not speak unless necessary.
Example:

Cassidy sitting under the mixing desk for an hour, refusing to come out until a buzzing light bulb is changed.

Level 4: The Meltdown
System Purge

Internal State: Critical Failure. Fight or Flight. The brain believes it is under physical attack. Logic is gone; only sensory pain remains.

  • Signs: Explosive emotion (crying/shouting), motor agitation (pacing), flight risk.
  • Protocol: "Clear the Room." Remove audience. Dim lights. Do not restrain unless unsafe.
Example:

Smashing a guitar not out of anger, but because the sound of the feedback loop physically hurt.

Level 5: The Collapse
CODE CARRY

Internal State: Total System Crash. Time ceases to exist. The body feels like it is vibrating apart. Subject is trapped in a loop of sensory agony.

  • Signs: Drop to floor (loss of motor control), self-injury (hitting head), fetal position, hands clamped over ears.
  • Protocol: "Deep Pressure / Extraction."
    Immediate grounding via weighted pressure. If environment is hostile (e.g., Omni-Global Meeting), physical extraction is mandatory.
Historical Record:

Incident: Omni-Global Pitch (2018)
Trigger: Threat to "Ad Astra" Master
Severity: MAXIMUM (Worst Recorded)
Outcome: Full extraction via "Ironhead Wall."

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
